quest.title: Collection of Dragons and Snakes
quest.description: You decide to help Ema find the five missing books...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

talks.objective: Speak to the afterimage within the library

dialogues.text: Agh! Not a step closer, you fiends! No borrowing at these hours!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Don't shout at us so suddenly! We're not here to borrow books. We don't even know how to read Byakuyakoku's script.
Ah. Whew, alright. I'm fine now.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Um, let me introduce myself. My name would be Ema in the Inazuman style. I'm the librarian here... At least until the day ends.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Until the day ends?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: That's right. We're all moving to live above sea level tomorrow. Now, if only I could get those five darn books back...

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: I'm rather ticked off right now, if you must know. Why, if Tokoyo Ookami in Enkanomiya had eyes to see, it would surely leave a Shade of Tokoyo for me behind right now!

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: The angriest, most anxious person in Enkanomiya — that's me, Ema!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What did you lose that's got you so anxious?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: The books are not that important. What's important is that this is Byakuyakoku's final day!

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: I don't want to go down in history as the librarian who could never get some books back, even up till the last day!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: (That's true, this afterimage of her is forever stuck on her final day.)

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: *sobs* I'm sorry, Mom and Dad, I've just been a waste of effort to bring up, haven't I? Ah, Divine Priestess, Lord Watatsumi Omikami, I've betrayed your trust, haven't I?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: When we get to the surface, I'll consign myself to guarding the Deep Sea Spiritherb. You know what? If reincarnation exists, I'll guard it in my next life too!

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: You can't be blamed for a job done poorly if all you do is delegate young people to run some errands, right? Right?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: ...Actually, speaking of young people and errands...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh-oh!

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Wait, wait, please! Don't run off just yet! I mean, you two look kind of busy anyway... right?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, yes...

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Great. Since you're running around Enkanomiya at the moment, could you see if you can help me find these books?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: I mean, I'm not expecting much, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, fine. Let's just help her, shall we, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: After all, she's been reliving her last day for... a few thousand years now.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: At the moment, the books that have yet to be returned are "The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku," "Hydrological Studies in Byakuyakoku," "In the Light, Beneath the Shadow," and the records of experiments conducted by Michiya and the people with him...

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: As for the fifth book, I actually have some idea where it might be.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: "Before Sun and Moon" was stolen, and the suspects have been locked up in the hanging prison beneath Dainichi Mikoshi.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: The Jibashiri threatened them, saying that if they didn't give its location up, they would be abandoned in the hanging prison. They would be the last three people left in Enkanomiya.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Of course, that was only intended to scare them. When it comes time to move tomorrow, they will probably be released.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Don't tell them that, though! Among the suspects is a guy called Antei. He's got a real temper, and isn't the type to give anything up unless you really threaten him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like a tough guy to get along with...

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, you can start from there whenever you're free.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. I mean, I wasn't expecting anything... or anything...

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: How are things going with the unreturned books?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Y—You got them all?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: These four books are the ones I'm looking for, yes... But what's with this copy of "The Serpent and Drakes of Tokoyokoku"?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: It doesn't have the unified cover that our collection uses, and I can't read a word of it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, we actually can't read your script... But we can confirm that this is the right book.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Really? You're not just trying to trick me, are you? I mean, I'm not trying to make life hard for you. But I... I think I might get another anxiety attack. Could you... tell me what this book is about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You tell Ema about Watatsumi Omikami's victory over the Bathysmal Vishap...

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: That... is the story of this book, yes. Well, if you say so, I'll believe you.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Ah, now that all the books are back, it's like a weight has been lifted off my back.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Guess I won't have to look after that Deep Sea Spiritherb after all. You know what? I've decided that when I get up above the surface, I'm going to become a master of raw fish dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: After tomorrow, come look for me on Watatsumi Island. I'll show you what I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you make raw fish dishes often, Ema?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Not really. Haven't touched a kitchen knife in my life, really. But I'm the only one who has read a lot of books about Narukami Island cuisine. You might even consider me the first person in Byakuyakoku to know about the thing they call "sashimi."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Just be careful not to cut yourself, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Hah, I won't argue with you further. I'll let my cooking do the talking! Just you wait!

dialogues.speaker: Ema
dialogues.text: Alright then, please help me put the books back on that shelf over there.

talks.objective: Return the books to their shelves
Investigate the picture frame that has changed

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek! What just happened?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The picture frame over there just lit up!
